violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) at ambient temperature: blue butter (66f), truffle butter (65f) Upon discussion with PIC, butters were placed on the counter about 2.5 hours prior to inspection
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO KEEP BUTTERS AT 41f AT ALL TIMES. PIC AGREED TO DISCARD BUTTERS IN 1.5 HOURS.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: 1) beurre blanc sauces
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC WROTE THE END POINT TIME ON THE LABEL. MORTON'S OF CHICAGO RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 07/09/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) main dish machine was observed not sanitizing
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC CALLED A SERVICE TECHNICIAN DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the ceiling panels and walls around the front cookline heavily stained yellow. Observed the air vents above the two steak broilers with black staining.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR prep top pantry cooler: cut tomatoes (44f), ranch dressing (45f), blue cheese dressing (46f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) lobster stock; 2) chipotle sauce; 3) candied steak
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: A unlabeled spray bottle of sanitizer was observed at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. BARTENDER LABELED THE SPRAY BOTTLE. LABEL ALL CHEMICAL CONTAINERS, SPRAY BOTTLES, ETC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: Observed wood being used to prevent the microwave from moving around on a prep top table next to the 2DR prep top pantry cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC REMOVED THE WOOD.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 2DR prep top pantry cooler was observed at 50f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC CALLED A SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE COOLER. DO NOT STORE FOOD IN THIS COOLER OVERNIGHT. USE ICE IN THE TOP PORTION TO KEEP FOOR COLD DURING SERVICE. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32-38f.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: A backflow prevention device was not observed on the water line at the coffee station.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE A LICENSED PLUMBER INSTALL AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw shelled eggs being stored over butter in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE EGGS TO THE BOTTOM SHELF NEXT TO THE BUTTER.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed portioned imitation crab meat being stored in the 2DR upright along the cook line for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.
